name: Amy
source: Lara's best friend. Her little sister, Tammy, was found dead a few months after her disappearance by Jack, the local gardener, a few miles down the river. Identifying her body was not an easy task, and even after her autopsy, people were not sure what had happened to her. Despite this, Amy refuses to believe it and thinks that Tammy is still alive.
